steps.title: Render & Upload 3-Act Bleak Symphonic Moving Storybook Album (1080p30 + Zero-Warp H3 + 5-Lang SEO)
steps.description:
Canonical recipe, traps and acceptance checks: /home/wayne/workspace/github/slashman413/ai-lofi-music-vid-yt/docs/STORYBOOK_RUNBOOK.md (read it first; it wins over this text).

Execute the fixed Moving Storybook pipeline from your task's artifacts directory ($COWORK_ARTIFACTS_DIR):

python3 /home/wayne/workspace/github/slashman413/ai-lofi-music-vid-yt/src/storybook_pipeline.py \
  --work-dir . \
  --past-used /home/wayne/workspace/github/slashman413/ai-lofi-music-vid-yt/config/past_used.json \
  --engine acestep15 \
  --acts 3 --tracks-per-act 3 --song-seconds 180 \
  --shots-per-track 2 --shot-loop-seconds 10.0 --i2v-mode h3 \
  --foley-lufs -36.0 --export-ep --upload

Verify:
1. 1920x1080 @ 30fps MP4 with zero horizontal warping/jitter in 10s MiniMax H3 loops (1024x576 exact 16:9 pre-resized keyframes + phase-correlation registration, forward-only loop).
2. Bleak, desolate, melancholic ghibli-style gouache visual tone (ghibli_style.safetensors @ 0.85 + cold slate-indigo grading) in covers_contact.jpg.
3. Monumental 80-piece symphonic audio via ACE-Step 1.5 2-LoRA stack + Regrind V10b VAE + Symphonic Fullness EQ (-14 LUFS, LRA 16), with zero white-noise hiss (pure silence Foley in non-rain acts, -36 LUFS <850Hz rain patter in rain acts).
4. 5-language SEO metadata (zh-TW, zh-CN, en, es, ja, ko) in multilang_metadata.json, full_description.txt, and YouTube localizations.
